text: Jess, do you remember that night we went to the park?
Oh, God, it was so hot.
We brought a loaf of stale bread to give to the ducks.
I never knew there could be so many ducks in one pond.
And you, you ran from them.
Oh, they were going to eat me.
Do you remember what happened when we got rid of them?
It was so hot. Your skin was so slippery.
That tree. You had to stop moving any time anybody came close.
And you, you made those sounds, those sexy whimpers, because you couldn't stand it.
Kill her like you killed your mother.
